requirements.desc: definition.js shall stop exporting raw FLOW_DEFINITION and TASK_DEFINITION and instead expose definition-side APIs for node lookup, task node lookup, leaf id collection, phase/action mapping, definition order, active node lookup, maxAttempts, sideEffects, runtime step resolution, and lifecycle resolution.
Steps-array-only utilities shall move out of definition.js into a dedicated step-tree module, and all consumers shall import those utilities from the step-tree module.

FlowNode or equivalent definition-side node objects shall carry lifecycle behavior using dedicated action classes with constructor-enforced invariants for status transitions, keep-in-progress behavior, metric increments, issue-log appends, side-effect execution, skip behavior, and hook escape hatches.

Definition-side lifecycle resolution shall cover review/gate/finalize status transitions, draft PASS empty triage/repair artifact generation, implementation-review proposal evidence reset from test-execute through finalize-cleanup, downstream skip/reset behavior, sideEffects, maxAttempts, and runtime log step resolution for the lifecycle cases named in Issue #370.

registry.js hooks shall delegate lifecycle decisions to definition-side APIs or shared lifecycle application helpers and shall not hardcode flow step ids, review phase maps, gate phase maps, or finalize downstream leaf lists for definition-derived decisions.
Production modules, helper modules, and tests shall be migrated away from raw definition imports so no caller depends on FLOW_DEFINITION or TASK_DEFINITION as exported data.
Existing flow CLI command names, options, help text, JSON envelope shapes, step ids, status transitions, and exit behavior shall remain user-visible compatible after the refactor.

Spec-local tests shall verify the new definition/registry boundary, raw export removal, step-tree utility relocation, lifecycle action class invariants, draft PASS artifact preservation, implementation-review proposal evidence reset, and representative review/gate/finalize lifecycle transitions.
If implementation changes documented flow internals, docs shall be rebuilt or updated through the project flow; otherwise docs shall remain unchanged.
